profile.name: Farm
profile.description: Sets up isolated Claude Code and optional Codex seats on this bot’s computer and routes fat jobs so the chat only sees compact results. For anyone who wants extra model capacity without running the work in this thread.

memory.content: Worker farm lives on the bot computer: SQLite control plane, one isolated profile dir per seat, one active job per worker, parallel only across workers. No quota hopping. The user signs in on that computer; passwords and tokens never go in chat or logs.

Submit fat unsupervised jobs (goal, constraints, done-when). Tick only leases. The operator then runs the CLI in that seat's profile dir and the worker writes compact result.json. Do not spend a strong seat on work a few dispatcher tool calls could finish.

Default two live seats until the user adds more: a stronger model for long/hard jobs, a volume model for research. Extra seats stay disabled. Cooldown that seat when the provider hits a limit; do not rotate the job to another login.
